body.p: A jay said: "Fox, let us jump around on the lake!" The lake was covered in ice slush, in a lot of ice slush. They jumped around, the jay left together with the fox. The jay was waving its wings, the fox landed on its paws. The fox went under there; the ice split, the fox said: "Jay, come bring the log." The jay said: "Take me, take me, wait!" The jay pressed the log further under [the ice]. The fox sank under [the ice], he found a roach. The mother of the roach was sick. The fox said: "I will shamanize for your mother." The roach said: "Oh-oh, let us shamanize." The fox said: "Get the children outside." The children swam outside, swam. They swam outside, he stabbed the mother in the belly with a knife. Having killed the mother, the fox ate all of it. The roach's children started to cry. They cried, their eyes turned red. Their eyes are still red today.[GVY:] Since the word for "eyes" is in the Accusative, the sentence may be translated as "they made their eyes red", though the original translation "their eyes have become red" sound more natural. The fox found a burbot, he said: "Let us go down the river." The burbot told the burbots: "When the fox screams, you respond." The fox ran away then. After passing by one part of the river, it screamed, the burbots responded further ahead. This one kept running by another part of the river and screamed again: "Burbot!" "Hey", the burbots responded further ahead. The fox ran and ran, it screamed again, the burbots again responded ahead. The fox was overtaken, it ran until it turned red-brown. The fox said: "Since I was overtaken, I am not fat anymore." The burbot said: "I will fatten my liver." The the fox met an old woman. The old woman asked: "Do you know your country?" "I know the country." "If you know it, let us go together, ride with me on my sledge", the old woman said. It climbed onto the sledge, they arrived at a lake. "What is its name?" "Its name is 'upper string'", the fox said. They kept going from there, they came to a lake again: "What is this one's name?" "Middle." They left again. "What is the name of the lake?", the old woman asked. The fox said: "Lower." This one said: "Grandmother, we are close to the old man." They arrived. The old woman said: "Do you know the reindeer meadow?" The fox said: "I know it, it is good. I, the grandfather, can bring the reindeer to the meadow." The old woman gave it the reindeer. One night went by, the fox came and said: "Grandfather, give a hammer to me, I will climb a tree, I am very bored." The old man gave him a hammer. When he died, the fox killed a male reindeer with the hammer, ate its bone marrow, hit with the hammer and said: "Grandmother, go look after your reindeer, they have become fat." The old man went, it [the fox] had killed all of the reindeer. He went to the old woman: "Catch the fox", he said. The old woman did not hear him well, she asked: "Fox, what did the grandfather say?" The fox ran away. The old man remained behind wanting to kill the fox. The old man became angry. The fox ran and told the old woman: "Attach fat to my tail." The old woman attached it to [VGM:] Белый цвет кончика хвоста лисицы эвенки объясняют тем, что на хвосте лисицы был привязан жир. Этот мотив встречается часто.the tail. The old man come to the old woman again, the fox ran away. The old man released a dog by the traces of the fox. When he had released the dog and it had caught up, the fox crept into the earth [into a cave]. The old man lit a fire in the hole. The fox jumped through the fire, came out of the burning fire, the fox said: "Leave a sleeve's length behind." It left but a sleeve's length of its tail in the fire.
